title: Automate changelog and onboard aurora-pro-lite-3b v1.3: metadata + perf profiles
author: Sana Patel
description: Motivation: onboard aurora-pro-lite-3b v1.3 with curated metadata and performance profiles, and wire it into our changelog automation so release notes are generated for model rollouts. This PR does three things in one: 1) adds model metadata/manifest (tokenizer, model_id, sample prompts, recommended quantization profiles), 2) adds perf profiles (throughput/latency/KV cache guidance) and a small perf test, and 3) extends the generate_release_notes pipeline so new model registry additions produce a preliminary changelog draft. Checklist: - [x] metadata.json for v1.3 - [x] perf profile yaml - [x] perf test + sample outputs - [x] changelog automation hook + example draft - [x] updated docs snippet and example - [x] CI passes and smoke-run on a small instance Notes: perf numbers are conservative (measured on g4dn with int8 runtime), quantization recommended is gpq8_2 for allocate-bound workloads, and a fallback profile for FP16 is provided for accuracy-sensitive customers. Related Linear: ENG-3124 (onboarding pipeline), PM-798 (release notes for model rollouts).
